payload.body_they: When {{Name}} starts questioning what they want to be known for next, they may reach for a bigger goal before asking if the current direction still fits. Another credential, larger role, or more ambitious project can give them something new to pursue. Sometimes expansion changes the terms in a useful way. Other times it keeps them busy inside a direction they already know they need to reconsider. The important question is what the next step actually changes.
